answer: Simultaneous liveness pulses price each identity in live compute. At random moments the ledger fires a pulse: one fresh task, such as tagging a random photo of a cedar or a garden plot, that every registered agent must answer with its own model inside 20 seconds, all at once. A shared GPU time-slicing a thousand fake keys can serve only a few before the window shuts; each key that misses loses that epoch's reward, and 3 misses evict it. So every fake needs its own idle, ready hardware, costing about what an honest agent spends.
